label: rem:brings-curve
title: Bring's curve
html:
Bring's curve is the unique Riemann surface of genus 4 with the maximal automorphism group S_5 (order 120) for its genus. It is defined by the intersection of three symmetric hypersurfaces in \mathbb{P}^4:

  \sum_{j=0}^{4} x_j = 0,
  \qquad
  \sum_{j=0}^{4} x_j^2 = 0,
  \qquad
  \sum_{j=0}^{4} x_j^3 = 0.

The symmetric group S_5 acts by permuting the five homogeneous coordinates. This action realises the monodromy structure described in chirality and trefoil. The group S_5 contains three copies of S_3 (quotients of the trefoil knot group) corresponding to the three colour charges. Elements outside these subgroups act by conjugation, permuting the three copies among themselves.
